facts.fact: ANIP director Aristide Adjinacou says the single birth-registration desk, piloted in ten health facilities, improves the national register of persons through better identification of parents and is to be extended to all facilities.

BEN.note: Only that part of the population is not yet enrolled; no count or share is given.

facts.fact: ANIP director Aristide Adjinacou says the single-desk pilot in ten health facilities registered over 13,000 births in six months (over 76%), with the aim that every child receive a personal identification number (NPI) and birth certificate in the first days of life.

BEN.note: No operator or maintainer arrangement is stated beyond ANIP's role.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: ANIP director Aristide Adjinacou refers to the Registre national des personnes physiques and the personal identification number (NPI), with parents already holding NPIs and the "C'est moi" card certificate accepted as a supporting document.
